mutants.name: M3-always-launch-fold-check
mutants.why: Removing the baseline guard (if baseline_path is not None) causes fold_check to be launched even when no baseline exists — the subprocess fails and fold_val becomes N/A instead of NO_BASELINE. test_bar_met_no_baseline_unaffected expects fold_check=NO_BASELINE; this mutant produces N/A and breaks the BATTERY: line assertion.

mutants.name: M4-suppress-battery-line-for-continue
mutants.why: Gating the BATTERY: line on verdict=='BAR_MET' hides the battery result for CONTINUE exits entirely. test_continue_plan_lint_fail_no_downgrade_warn asserts exactly one BATTERY: line is present in warnings; the mutation produces zero — the suite catches it.

mutants.name: M5-battery-on-escalate
mutants.why: Running the battery inside _escalate would launch tools on ESCALATE arms; test 7 asserts zero battery-tool launches there.

mutants.name: M6-vacuous-treated-as-drift
mutants.why: Mapping the VACUOUS exit to DRIFT would withhold the bar at every honest dry close; test 4 asserts BAR_MET unaffected on VACUOUS.

mutants.name: M7-vacuous-token-mismatch
mutants.why: Matching a different token than the machine-readable FOLD-CHECK VACUOUS prefix drops the VACUOUS state to NO_BASELINE; test 8 asserts the emitter writes VACUOUS for it.

mutants.name: M8-drift-mapped-to-na
mutants.why: Mapping rc 1 back to N/A is the thread-190 conflation; test 3 asserts DRIFT downgrades and test 8 asserts the emitter writes DRIFT.

mutants.name: M9-emitter-runs-battery-twice
mutants.why: Dropping the battery= hand-off makes emit_manifest launch every tool twice; test 12 asserts exactly once.

mutants.name: M10-drop-fold-warn-when-both-fire
mutants.why: Suppressing the fold_check WARN when plan_lint also fails collapses the both-fire case to one line; test 3 covers the both-fire assertion.

mutants.why: Skipping the battery when no warnings list is passed makes the verdict depend on the call shape (the #100040 defect); test 15 asserts three call shapes agree.
